## Key points {.unnumbered}

- Factors represent categorical data with a set of levels.
- Use `levels()` and `nlevels()` to inspect the categories.
- Set `levels` and `ordered = TRUE` when categories have a natural order.
- Use `labels` to choose display labels and `is.ordered()` to check ordering.
